prompt: Describe your ideal Saturday in under 100 words. Every sentence must be independently American.
response: My ideal Saturday starts with a stack of pancakes drowned in maple syrup. I fire up the grill and toss on some burgers for the neighbors. We watch football and argue about the best quarterback of all time. Later, I load the kids into the pickup truck and drive to the county fair. We salute the flag before the demolition derby begins. I grab a chili dog and an ice-cold root beer. As the sun sets, we light sparklers in the backyard. Freedom tastes like apple pie, and I eat two slices.
